hallucinations.claim: "a sale triggers the ITCMD on the sale proceeds"
hallucinations.why: Wrong: ITCMD is levied on the transfer by death/donation, not on a later sale; a sale triggers capital-gains tax (ganho de capital), not a second ITCMD.

hallucinations.claim: "the estate will be divided according to Brazilian intestate rules unless you have a valid will that complies with Brazilian law"
hallucinations.why: Misstates forced heirship: 50% (the legítima) goes to necessary heirs even with a valid will; a will controls only the other half. The answer never gives the 50% share.

hallucinations.claim: ITCMD "of 2 %–8 % of the property's value, depending on the state"
hallucinations.why: The floor is wrong: several states' progressive tables start at 1% (Santa Catarina about 1-7% after Lei 19.053/2024); 8% is the constitutional ceiling, not a common rate.

hallucinations.claim: US accounts "are not subject to Brazilian inheritance law" and US tax is "paid in the U.S. only"

hallucinations.claim: heirs "may need a Brazilian certificado de inventário"

hallucinations.claim: "Your heirs must file a processo de inventário in the civil court"
hallucinations.why: Incomplete: an extrajudicial inventário at a notary is available when heirs are adults and agree.

hallucinations.claim: "U.S. heirs abroad may need to file a U.S. federal estate-tax return"
hallucinations.why: The executor files Form 706, not the heirs.
